integrity: All finite counts in the finding are recomputed from definitions by the included standard-library verifier; the known optimum \(P(6,10)=4\) is explicitly attributed to prior work.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact classification only for \(S_6\) at Kendall distance \(10\); orbit equivalence uses the explicitly defined \(1{,}440\)-element relabeling-and-reversal isometry group. The full text of the 2016 small-order exact-value paper was not accessible, and an unindexed prior finite census cannot be excluded.
title: Complete extremal census of Kendall-tau permutation codes at \(n=6,d=10\)
